entries.en: to punish; to chastise
entries.notes: H栏汉字有[疑]（責罰/懲罰），但R栏 chiè fâ 与M栏 chēng hūan 互证为「责罚」。

entries.en: to punish; to inflict punishment
punishment; penalty

entries.zh: 处决（对已判罪者行刑）；除去
entries.en: to execute (a condemned man); to put to death
entries.notes: L栏 matalle 有[疑]，读作 matarle（杀死他）方与H「除」、M「Tū」相合。

entries.en: to punish for correction; to discipline
to chastise; to inflict a corrective punishment
to discipline; to punish as a warning
to reprove; to rebuke (an offender)
to punish; to correct
to strip; to fleece (to punish by taking away)
entries.notes: L为「castigar; corregir」，H「剝削」取其古义「剥夺、搜刮」，非今义「剥削」。

entries.en: to reprimand; to reproach
entries.notes: L栏 a stios 词形可疑（疑缩写或讹写），H「責備」与R chiè pēy 一致。

entries.zh: 口头责罚；斥骂（H栏作「烹调」，与西语词头不合，疑栏位错置）
entries.en: to punish with words; to scold (H reads 'to cook'; column shift suspected)
entries.notes: H「烹調」、M peng tiāu 与 castigar de palabra 语义不合，R pēng piān 亦不与「調」对应；暂从词头释义。

entries.zh: 枷责；杖责（缚于板上受刑）
entries.en: to flog (a culprit bound to a board); to beat
entries.notes: H有[疑]（枷責/加責）；L coſtando a natabla 疑为 acostado en la tabla 之讹，与「枷责」相合。

entries.en: to reprove; to censure
entries.notes: L「ael Preo」词形不全（疑 reo/preso），M栏另有 pēy ney 冗余音节，语义以H「譴責」为准。

entries.en: to punish and reprove (an offender)
to fix a penalty; to propose a punishment
entries.notes: L「ael Preo」词形不全，H「擬罰」与R ngīn fâ、M gî hūar 互证一致。

entries.en: penal law; punishment (as a legal institution)
to punish rigorously; strict law
entries.notes: H有[疑]（嚴法/叒法），R ngiên fâ、M giām hûar 支持「嚴法」。

entries.zh: 未成事而先罚；擅自惩处（原件疑损，释义存疑）
entries.en: to punish before the deed is done (text damaged; uncertain)
entries.notes: L fuech 与H「擅自/變自」均标[疑]，M/R pièn chū/zū 不足以定夺，仅存疑记录。

entries.en: to punish severely; heavy punishment
entries.notes: L「peradamto」疑为缩写或讹写，H「重責」与R chōng chiē、M tōng chēg 一致。

entries.en: to punish by exile; to rid the people of a menace
to punish as a warning; to make an example of
entries.notes: H有[疑]（儆戒/敬戒）；L尾部 en la ĝa 为缩写、字义不明，caiga 示「使知警」之义。
